audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim Shema, covenant love, teaching, remembrance, and child-question discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Shema, love with heart/soul/might, words on heart, teaching children, binding/doorpost signs, prosperity and forgetting, exclusive service, Massah warning, and Exodus catechesis.

verses.restored: This is command, statutes, and judgments YHWH your Divine commanded to teach you, to do in land where you are crossing to possess it,

familiar.text: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

modern.text: These are the commandments and statutes and ordinances that the LORD your God has instructed me to teach you to follow in the land that you are about to enter and possess,

original.text: וְזֹ֣את הַמִּצְוָ֗ה הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם לְלַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ

verses.restored: so you may fear/revere YHWH your Divine, keeping all his statutes and commands that I command you—you, your child, and your child's child—all days of your life, and so your days may lengthen.

familiar.text: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

modern.text: so that you and your children and grandchildren may fear the LORD your God all the days of your lives by keeping all His statutes and commandments that I give you, and so that your days may be prolonged.

original.text: לְמַ֨עַן תִּירָ֜א אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ לִ֠שְׁמֹר אֶת כָּל חֻקֹּתָ֣יו וּמִצְוֺתָיו֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוֶּךָ֒ אַתָּה֙ וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבֶן בִּנְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ וּלְמַ֖עַן יַאֲרִכֻ֥ן יָמֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Hear, Israel, and keep to do, so it may be well with you and you may multiply greatly, as YHWH Divine of your fathers spoke to you, in land flowing with milk and honey.

familiar.text: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

modern.text: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to observe them, so that you may prosper and multiply greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

original.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְךָ֔ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְבּ֖וּן מְאֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֨יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ

verses.restored: Hear, Israel: YHWH is our Divine, YHWH is one.

familiar.text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:

modern.text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.

original.text: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֶחָֽד

verses.restored: You shall love YHWH your Divine with all your heart, with all your soul/life, and with all your might/veryness.

familiar.text: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

modern.text: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

original.text: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכָל נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכָל מְאֹדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: These words that I command you today shall be upon your heart.

familiar.text: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

modern.text: These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.

original.text: וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם עַל לְבָבֶֽךָ

verses.restored: You shall repeat/teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit in your house, when you walk on way, when you lie down, and when you rise.

familiar.text: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

modern.text: And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

original.text: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּ֣ם לְבָנֶ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֖ בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֨ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ

verses.restored: You shall bind them as sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.

familiar.text: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

modern.text: Tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

original.text: וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall write them upon doorposts of your house and upon your gates.

familiar.text: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

modern.text: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.

original.text: וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל מְזוּזֹ֥ת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: It shall be when YHWH your Divine brings you into land he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give you—great and good cities you did not build,

familiar.text: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

modern.text: And when the LORD your God brings you into the land He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He would give you—a land with great and splendid cities that you did not build,

original.text: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּ֥י יְבִיאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֶל הָאָ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם לְיִצְחָ֥ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לָ֣תֶת לָ֑ךְ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וְטֹבֹ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא בָנִֽיתָ

verses.restored: houses full of every good thing you did not fill, hewn cisterns you did not hew, vineyards and olive trees you did not plant—and you eat and are satisfied,

familiar.text: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

modern.text: with houses full of every good thing with which you did not fill them, with wells that you did not dig, and with vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant—and when you eat and are satisfied,

original.text: וּבָ֨תִּ֜ים מְלֵאִ֣ים כָּל טוּב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא מִלֵּאתָ֒ וּבֹרֹ֤ת חֲצוּבִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא חָצַ֔בְתָּ כְּרָמִ֥ים וְזֵיתִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא נָטָ֑עְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ

verses.restored: guard yourself lest you forget YHWH who brought you out from land of Egypt, from house of slaves.

familiar.text: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

modern.text: be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

original.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצִֽיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים

verses.restored: YHWH your Divine you shall fear/revere, him you shall serve, and by his name you shall swear.

familiar.text: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

modern.text: Fear the LORD your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.

original.text: אֶת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א וְאֹת֣וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ

verses.restored: You shall not go after other gods from gods of peoples around you,

familiar.text: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

modern.text: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you.

original.text: לֹ֣א תֵֽלְכ֔וּן אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים מֵאֱלֹהֵי֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: for a jealous Divine is YHWH your Divine in your midst, lest anger of YHWH your Divine burn against you and destroy you from face of ground.

familiar.text: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

modern.text: For the LORD your God, who is among you, is a jealous God. Otherwise the anger of the LORD your God will be kindled against you, and He will wipe you off the face of the earth.

original.text: כִּ֣י אֵ֥ל קַנָּ֛א יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ פֶּן יֶ֠חֱרֶה אַף יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְהִשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה

verses.restored: You shall not test YHWH your Divine as you tested at Massah.

familiar.text: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

modern.text: Do not test the LORD your God as you tested Him at Massah.

original.text: לֹ֣א תְנַסּ֔וּ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִסִּיתֶ֖ם בַּמַּסָּֽה

verses.restored: You shall diligently keep commands of YHWH your Divine and his testimonies and statutes that he commanded you.

familiar.text: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

modern.text: You are to diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God and the testimonies and statutes He has given you.

original.text: שָׁמ֣וֹר תִּשְׁמְר֔וּן אֶת מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְעֵדֹתָ֥יו וְחֻקָּ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ

verses.restored: You shall do right and good in eyes of YHWH, so it may be well with you and you may enter and possess good land YHWH swore to your fathers,

familiar.text: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,

modern.text: Do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may be well with you and that you may enter and possess the good land that the LORD your God swore to give your fathers,

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר וְהַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ וּבָ֗אתָ וְיָֽרַשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as YHWH spoke.

familiar.text: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.

modern.text: driving out all your enemies before you, as the LORD has said. Teach Your Children

original.text: לַהֲדֹ֥ף אֶת כָּל אֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: When your child asks you tomorrow, saying, What are testimonies and statutes and judgments YHWH our Divine commanded you?

familiar.text: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?

modern.text: In the future, when your son asks, “What is the meaning of the decrees and statutes and ordinances that the LORD our God has commanded you?”

original.text: כִּֽי יִשְׁאָלְךָ֥ בִנְךָ֛ מָחָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר מָ֣ה הָעֵדֹ֗ת וְהַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֶתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: you shall say to your child: We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt, and YHWH brought us out from Egypt with strong hand.

familiar.text: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

modern.text: then you are to tell him, “We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

original.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לְבִנְךָ֔ עֲבָדִ֛ים הָיִ֥ינוּ לְפַרְעֹ֖ה בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֧נוּ יְהוָ֛ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH gave signs and wonders, great and harmful, against Egypt, Pharaoh, and all his house before our eyes.

familiar.text: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

modern.text: Before our eyes the LORD inflicted great and devastating signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his household.

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֡ה אוֹתֹ֣ת וּ֠מֹפְתִים גְּדֹלִ֨ים וְרָעִ֧ים בְּמִצְרַ֛יִם בְּפַרְעֹ֥ה וּבְכָל בֵּית֖וֹ לְעֵינֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: He brought us out from there in order to bring us in, to give us land he swore to our fathers.

familiar.text: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

modern.text: But He brought us out from there to lead us in and give us the land that He had sworn to our fathers.

original.text: וְאוֹתָ֖נוּ הוֹצִ֣יא מִשָּׁ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן֙ הָבִ֣יא אֹתָ֔נוּ לָ֤תֶת לָ֨נוּ֙ אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: YHWH commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear/revere YHWH our Divine, for our good all days, to keep us alive, as this day.

familiar.text: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

modern.text: And the LORD commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear the LORD our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.

original.text: וַיְצַוֵּ֣נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְיִרְאָ֖ה אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְט֥וֹב לָ֨נוּ֙ כָּל הַיָּמִ֔ים לְחַיֹּתֵ֖נוּ כְּהַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: It shall be righteousness for us when we keep to do all this command before YHWH our Divine, as he commanded us.

familiar.text: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.

modern.text: And if we are careful to observe every one of these commandments before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, then that will be our righteousness.”

original.text: וּצְדָקָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶה לָּ֑נוּ כִּֽי נִשְׁמֹ֨ר לַעֲשׂ֜וֹת אֶת כָּל הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֗את לִפְנֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽנוּ

translation_notes: The Shema—Deuteronomy 6:4-9—is central living Jewish prayer and covenant practice. It must not be detached from Judaism, Christianized, or treated as superseded.
Echad may express one, unique, or unified; the restored line preserves the traditional compact ambiguity.
Heart, soul/life, and might/veryness describe total embodied devotion, not emotional coercion or erasure of self.
Teaching occurs through ordinary daily rhythms and later Jewish practices of tefillin and mezuzah deserve explicit respect.

The warning about enjoying cities, houses, cisterns, vineyards, and olive trees not created by Israel exposes the danger of forgetting both liberation and the labor/displacement behind inherited abundance.
The child's answer begins with slavery and liberation, making Exodus the interpretive center of commandment.
safety_note: Do not appropriate the Shema against Jewish people, use love of Divine to coerce emotion or suppress identity, or weaponize this chapter for conquest. Center Jewish continuity, daily teaching, gratitude, remembrance of slavery, and responsibility within inherited abundance.
